failure_modes: large app.web coupling
thread failure hidden by best-effort catches
shutdown/restart state split across globals and files
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Keep API/UI as a read-model consumer; extract fast and slow path services behind feature flags and replace globals with explicit lifecycle state.

inputs: KIS WebSocket trade and order-book frames
REST ranking APIs for symbol discovery
blocking_calls: synchronous SQLite persistence from message consumption
approval-key and ranking REST calls outside frame parsing
failure_modes: no authoritative per-stream gap state
callback can include storage work
session/fill stream is not unified with market stream
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Adapt parsed frames to versioned events, update in-memory state first, and move persistence/feature publication to bounded queues.

inputs: KIS overseas REST quote and order-book endpoints
outputs: synthetic realtime tick/book records in the shared SQLite store
failure_modes: REST is used as a latency-sensitive feed
exceptions are swallowed
timestamp touching can obscure source event age
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Retain as bounded fallback/bootstrap only; add an overseas WebSocket provider before enabling the refactor fast path for US symbols.

failure_modes: no versioned reversible migration chain
decision callbacks can synchronously persist
separate stores require reconciliation
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Keep SQLite initially; add versioned journal migrations and async persistence, then evaluate Parquet/DuckDB only for offline history.

failure_modes: features are rebuilt from stored windows rather than a single incremental market state
universal thresholds coexist with regime logic
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Preserve tested formulas, add incremental accumulators and causal rolling quantile state, and publish immutable FeatureSnapshot values.

failure_modes: theories can vote directly on direction
closed-world operational gate is not a distinct versioned snapshot
TTL is not uniform for all dynamic assertions
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Reuse TBox and validated rules, materialize a time-valid closed-world OntologyDecision, and restrict output to strategy admissibility and compatibility.

failure_modes: no durable strategy instance owns the entire position lifecycle
multiple theories contribute to a final direction
router and lifecycle are not separate
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Wrap existing experts behind a common lifecycle, route only ontology-admissible stock-strategy utility evidence, and keep legacy voting enabled for comparison.

failure_modes: verdict is not a first-class causal event tied to a strategy instance
risk result can construct FinalOrder directly
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Adapt existing checks to the typed RiskVerdict contract; allow only approve, resize, reject, or predefined emergency exit.

ambiguous timeout needs broker-side recovery
components.replacement_or_adapter_plan: Preserve KIS client as authoritative gateway; stage OrderIntent and RiskVerdict durably before submission and reconcile ambiguous outcomes before retry.

side_effects: updates dashboard and trading engine state
